item.title: The Return of ASAP Rocky, “Don’t be Dumb” Album Review
item.description: After eight years of radio silence, rapper, producer, model and fashion designer ASAP Rocky finally released his latest studio album “Don’t be Dumb”. After a couple of listens, the album certainly demonstrated its charm and charisma. While it wasn’t quite up to par with his earlier records, it’s still a great listen on its own. The post The Return of ASAP Rocky, “Don’t be Dumb” Album Review appeared first on KRUI Radio.
